$comment: Project harness. These hooks execute shell from scripts/claude/ - read them before trusting them; they are committed precisely so they can be read. The guards fail OPEN when jq is missing and session-brief.sh announces that at the top of every session, because a guard that stops guarding in silence is the defect this project keeps shipping. See docs/harness.md.
$comment_deny: The deny rules below are written as Edit(...) and that is NOT a narrowing to the Edit tool: a path denied here is refused for Write and NotebookEdit too. Checked on 2026-08-12 by attempting a Write to apps/api/internal/db/sqlc/ and a Write to apps/web/src/routeTree.gen.ts; both were refused with 'File is in a directory that is denied by your permission settings', and both shapes are covered - the ** prefix rule and the single-file rule. None of this reaches a Bash write; scripts/claude/bash-guard.sh covers that, and its header states what it cannot cover.
